column1: # note: supplementary: Rustle's two configurations on every registry sample, each against its own annotation; numbers from different samples or species are never pooled

# note: sn / pr / matching = gffcompare 0.12.10 intron-chain level (fractions; denominators: multi-exon reference / query transcripts); *_ge2 = sensitivity on the distinct multi-exon reference chains carried exactly by >= 2 primary alignments (-F 2308, count mode 'reads'; the fig1_support rule)

# note: annotations: human samples CHM13 v2.0 RefSeq; gorilla samples GCF_029281585.2 RefSeq; chimpanzee GCF_028858775.2 and orangutan GCF_028885625.2 RefSeq GFF3 converted with gff_to_gtf (the converter of the human and gorilla GTFs; the gorilla GFF3 converted this way is byte-identical to the gorilla GTF, md5 17052eec)

# note: human (human_A119b): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers; left out for every method because the annotation has no record there: chrM (transcripts there: rustle 39, rustle_primary 39)

# note: human_testis (human_testis): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers; left out for every method because the annotation has no record there: chrM (transcripts there: rustle 9, rustle_primary 9)
# note: gorilla (gorilla_OR6737): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers (all contigs)
# note: gorilla_KB3781 (gorilla_KB3781): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers (all contigs)
# note: chimp_PTR (chimp_PTR): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers (all contigs)
# note: orangutan_PPY (orangutan_PPY): genome-wide = every contig its annotation covers (all contigs)
